title: Hotel booking domain model
idea: The hotel domain model separates the building (Hotel, Room, RoomType) from what a guest buys (a Reservation of one RoomType over a DateRange).

analogy.text: A car rental desk sells you "a compact for three days", not a plate number. The exact car is handed over at pickup.
analogy.breaks: A hotel counts units per night; a rental counts cars per pickup.

points: A Hotel has Rooms; each Room belongs to exactly one RoomType.
A Reservation names one Guest, one RoomType and one DateRange.
DateRange is a value object: check-out is exclusive, nights are derived.
CancellationPolicy is an interface, so each rate plan can refund differently.

edges.label: has 1..*
edges.caption: A Hotel owns its Rooms. A Room never moves to another hotel.

edges.label: of type 1
edges.caption: Each Room is one RoomType. Many Rooms share a type, which holds the nightly rate.

edges.label: books 1
edges.caption: A Reservation books a RoomType, not a Room. That keeps rooms interchangeable.

edges.label: for 1
edges.caption: One Guest makes the Reservation. A Guest may hold many over time.

edges.label: has 1
edges.caption: The stay is a DateRange value object. Price is rate times nights.

edges.label: uses 1
edges.caption: The Reservation keeps the CancellationPolicy it was sold with, so later rule changes do not apply.

edges.label: 0..1 later
edges.caption: The assigned Room is empty until check-in. The front desk fills it.

edges.label: has
edges.caption: ReservationStatus is an enum. Page four turns it into a state machine.

code.title: The model in Java 17
code.caption: Records for fixed data, a class for Reservation because its status and room change. Constructors guard the invariants.

walk.text: Two RoomTypes with nightly rates in paise, and a Hotel with three Rooms.
A three-night Deluxe reservation that is free to cancel up to two days before.
Ask the policy for the refund on two different cancel dates.
Two invalid inputs are refused: too many guests and a zero-night stay.
DateRange refuses empty stays and derives nights; nobody stores a night count.
The policy is an interface; FreeUntilDaysBefore is one rule among many.
Status starts HELD, room is empty, and money is a long in minor units.

pitfalls: Do not put an availability flag on Room; availability is per night, not per room.
Store the CancellationPolicy with the Reservation; the hotel may change its rules later.
Keep money as long minor units; multiplying doubles by nights drifts.

quiz.q: What does the refund line for 03-09 print?
options: rejected: stay needs at least one night
quiz.why: Check-in is 03-10, so 03-09 is one day before. The policy refunds only when cancelling at least two days ahead.

takeaway: Reservations book a RoomType over a DateRange; Rooms are assigned later.

starters: Why is DateRange a record and not two fields on Reservation?
Should nightly rates live on RoomType or in a separate rate table?
How would I model one reservation with two rooms?
